content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Customer Resolutions. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David, I got a call saying there was a problem with my order, but I don't quite understand what's going on. I'm really stressed lately.

I'm so sorry to hear that. Let me assure you, I'll do everything I can to help. Could you please provide your full name and the email address linked to your Amazon account so I can look into this for you?
Yes, it's Margaret Ellis, and my email is margaret.ellis1952@gmail.com.
Thank you, Margaret. I'm pulling up your account now. I see a pending delivery for a tablet. Has anyone else in your household placed this order, or are you expecting this package?
No, I haven't ordered anything like that. My husband used to handle these things but he passed a few months ago. I haven't bought anything recently.

I'm so sorry for your loss, Margaret. Please don't worry, we take these matters very seriously. It appears someone may have tried to use your account. For your security, I'll need to verify your billing address, could you confirm that for me?
It's 486 Willow Avenue, Stamford, CT 06902.

Thank you for confirming. According to our records, the order is being held due to a regulatory policy. To process the cancellation and protect your account, Amazon requires a temporary customs clearance fee, which is fully refundable. Have you seen any notifications about this in your email or Amazon app?
No, I just got a call. I didn't see anything like that before.

That's understandable. Sometimes these communications can get lost in spam folders. The fee is a recent Amazon requirement to prevent fraudulent activities, and once it's submitted, your order will be canceled and a refund will be processed to your original payment method. I'll walk you through every step.
I'm not sure I understand. Why do I need to pay if I didn't order anything?

That's a great question. It's a standard security protocol. This formality ensures no unauthorized activity is charged to your account, and once confirmed, the hold will be lifted. You'll receive your refund within 24 hours. The process is quick and safe.
Alright, if it's necessary. What do I need to do?
First, I need to know how you usually make purchases on Amazon, do you use a debit card, credit card, or gift cards? This helps us determine the correct refund method for you.
Usually my debit card, sometimes my late husband's credit card.

Thank you for clarifying. For privacy, please do not share your full card number. Now, for the customs fee, Amazon's current policy requires it to be paid via Amazon gift cards. This is the safest and fastest way to process the clearance and the refund.
I don't really know how to get gift cards. Can't I just pay with my card?

I completely understand, Margaret. However, due to the nature of this fee and to protect your financial details, Amazon only accepts payment via gift card codes for regulatory holds. I'll explain how to purchase them, it's very straightforward and I'll guide you.
Okay, I guess. Where do I get them?

You can visit any major retailer, like Walmart, CVS, or Walgreens, and ask for Amazon gift cards. For your order, the customs clearance fee is $400. Please purchase four $100 Amazon gift cards. Keep your receipts, as you'll need them for the refund.
That's a lot of money for me right now... Are you sure I'll get it back?

Absolutely. As soon as the codes are submitted, I'll process the refund to your debit card. You'll see the funds returned within 24 hours. I'll stay on the line to make sure everything goes smoothly and answer any questions.
Alright... I'll try to get them this afternoon. What do I do once I have the cards?

Once you have the cards, scratch off the silver strip on the back and read me the claim codes. I'll enter them into your Amazon account system to confirm the fee is paid, then we can cancel the order and refund your money.
Okay, I'll call you when I have them. Is there anything else I need to do?
Just be sure to keep your receipts and the cards until we confirm the refund is complete. I'll be here to assist you every step of the way. If you need any help at the store, just let me know.
Thank you. I really hope this works. I can't deal with one more thing right now.
You're very welcome, Margaret. You're doing the right thing to keep your account safe. I'll stay connected to make sure everything is resolved quickly and smoothly for you.
Alright. I'll go to Walgreens now and call you back.
That sounds perfect. I'll be awaiting your call. Remember, if you have any questions or need help with the cards, I'm just a phone call away.
